retraction.reason: Retracted in M21: a partial election, 16 November 1913, for 37 of the 153 seats, and the first held under the 1911 constitution; the Democrats took 33 of the 37. It confirmed a dominance the atlas already shows by other means, and no consequence of this particular by-election round can be argued from the bibliography here.
